lines.zh: 我吊在叶背，随风轻轻摇
lines.en: I hang under the leaf, rocking gently.
I am green enough to match the leaf.
A fine thread holds me by the crown.
The leaf trembles; so do I.
I swing on the twig in small arcs.

lines.zh: 丛林里风不断，我一直在动
lines.en: The jungle wind never stops, so I never do.
There is a yellow-green cast to my shell.

lines.zh: 雨点打在叶上，我转半圈
lines.en: Rain hits the leaf; I turn half round.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把自己放低一点
lines.en: I lower myself a little.
The leaf veins cradle me.
I hang securely; no need to worry.

lines.zh: 风大了，我摆动得更明显
lines.en: The wind picks up; my swaying is plainer.
I keep to the leaf edge, out of the light.

lines.zh: 枝条上还有别的挂着的东西
lines.en: Something else hangs on this branch too.

lines.zh: 我随着整棵树一起呼吸
lines.en: I breathe along with the whole tree.
I drop an inch; the thread holds.
It is close inside the shell, but quiet.
Yellow-green hides me among the leaves.
I am waiting for a certain time.

lines.zh: 我什么也不做，就这样挂着
lines.en: I do nothing; I simply hang.
An insect hole in the leaf.

lines.zh: 蛹期不吃不喝，只等羽化。
lines.en: In this pupal stage I neither eat nor drink, only wait to emerge.
The change inside continues slowly.
The tree's shadow passes over me.
I hear a sound inside the trunk.
Light leaks down from above.
I am faintly warm.
The surface of my shell brightens a little.
I watch you from between the green leaves.
You nearly missed me.
Green on green is hard to tell.
You crane your neck; I am right above.
My shell is harder than the leaf.
You reach and cannot touch me.

lines.zh: 我吊在叶下，缓缓转过半圈。
lines.en: Hanging under the leaf, I slowly swing half around.
Your shadow falls near me.
I suppose you are looking for insects.
I am not a bug. Not now.
A small dent in the shell.
I am sent spinning.
The twig shakes for a while.
The body inside curls tight.
I cannot bear this kind of force.
I make a small sound.

lines.zh: 黄绿的壳被划出一道白痕。
lines.en: A white scratch runs across my lime-green shell.
I press to the leaf, unmoving.
Will this hasten the change?
Please, not another.
I cannot even eat the leaf itself.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我看不清
lines.en: I cannot see what is in your hand.
My mouthparts are not formed yet.
That will have to wait.

lines.zh: 你现在喂我，我只能挨着
lines.en: Feed me now and I can only bear it.
It smells sweet; a pity it is useless.
You hold the flower up beneath the leaf.

lines.zh: 我稍后会记得你的好意
lines.en: I will remember your kindness later.
At this moment I need nothing.
Put it away.

lines.zh: 叶子被我压弯，我晃起来
lines.en: The leaf bends under me and I swing.
The back of your hand brushes the stem.
My thread pulls very taut.
I nearly dropped.
I draw in a little.
Both you and the leaf are moving.
I swing a wide circle.
Do not blow at the leaf.

lines.zh: 这一下把水珠都震落了
lines.en: That shook all the droplets loose.
I slowly come to rest.
In this shape, there is nothing to speak of.
Ask when the wings have hardened.
There are few of my kind in this forest.
Then there will be colors to show.
Now is the time for waiting.
I am in no hurry; there is time.

lines.zh: 隔着这层壳，什么都做不了。
lines.en: With this shell between us, there is nothing to be done.
I do not fuss, nor hope.
That is a strange question to ask.
When I am out, we may speak of it.
I cannot even touch it.
It has fallen beneath the leaf.

lines.zh: 我的六足都裹在蛹壳里。
lines.en: All six of my legs are wrapped inside this shell.

lines.zh: 我看见它的时候它还在转
lines.en: It was still spinning when I saw it.

lines.zh: 挂在这里，我什么也做不了
lines.en: Hanging here, I can do nothing.
Put it farther off.
That did not come from me.

lines.zh: 我没有能拿东西的地方
lines.en: I have nowhere to hold things.
The leaf dips; I tilt.
This has nothing to do with me.
You are looking carefully.
I am just above your head.
Green hides a great deal.
I do not intend to hide.
Do not expect me to run either.
My thread is on the leaf stem.
This spot is out of your reach.
Looking at me is fine.
Just do not shake the tree.
I will wait for you to give up.
I have been under this leaf all along.
You have tried three angles.
The trunk blocks half your view.

lines.zh: 你每靠近一步，我晃一下
lines.en: Each step closer makes me sway.

lines.zh: 我的壳颜色越来越像叶
lines.en: My shell looks more leaf-like by the hour.
You cannot tell which leaf I am on.
The leaves above are too dense.
The longer you stand, the calmer I am.
The wind will hide my motion.
You may go.
Hanging here, I cannot strike.

lines.zh: 你碰我，只是把叶子压弯
lines.en: Touch me and the leaf only bends.
My shell is hard and will pinch.

lines.zh: 叶子上的水会落到你脸上
lines.en: Water from the leaf will land on your face.

lines.zh: 丝线被扯了一下，我晃得很凶
lines.en: The thread jerks; I swing wildly.
I have no legs to kick with.
The wind knocks me against the leaf.
At most I can hold still.
That hurt you more than me.
Do not shake me loose.
A caterpillar chose this leaf.

lines.zh: 我在叶背固定住了自己
lines.en: I have fixed myself beneath the leaf.
The jungle damp is just right.
A yellow-green shell does not stand out.
The light is good today.

lines.zh: 我选了一片朝下的叶子
lines.en: I picked a leaf facing downward.
The branches close around me.
I hear rain.
This is a new place.
I slowly go still.
The heat nears and the leaf wilts.
The thread parts; I fall.
Water seeps in, very cold.
The leaf is thrown up, and so am I.
Something grazes past the shell.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我在里面抖
lines.en: That force makes me shake inside.
While hanging, I need not feed.

lines.zh: 雷声把整片叶子震得发抖
lines.en: Thunder shakes the whole leaf.
I lose the leaf and keep falling.
